segments.title: Helldivers 2 Liberation Campaign
segments.notes: Case Blackwell replaces the standard news desk with a full Helldivers 2 co-op session alongside his brother Ryan and friend Fancy Rancid, progressing from bug planets to automaton fronts on escalating difficulties while learning stratagems, ship management, and rank customization.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a special Helldivers 2 gaming broadcast in place of the regular news desk, learning mechanics live with his brother and friend.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly appears on camera to hug Case, smokes a 'spliff of freedom,' and declines to play.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Referenced during a hype train event where Case notes new graphics unlock every five levels.

lore_notes.fact: Case's brother is named Ryan (Brian M. Blackwell) [01:55:29]
Fancy Rancid is a friend who streams on Twitch; Case promotes his channel [13:24]
Case unlocks and selects the 'Space Cadet' rank at level 6 [02:27:44]
Case mentions a friend 'Brine' who serves in the actual military and holds '10 star general' rank in-game, working toward 'Skull Admiral' [02:43:07]
Stream concludes with a raid to Daddy Rads, plus shoutouts to Nomi Pro and Daisy Line 13 [02:44:34]

episode_summary: Case Blackwell foregoes the standard news rundown for a Helldivers 2 co-op campaign with his brother Ryan and friend Fancy Rancid, dropping into bug and automaton operations across rising difficulties while mastering stratagem calls, ship upgrades, and rank titles. Kendelle makes a brief on-camera cameo. The broadcast ends with a raid to Daddy Rads.
